product.name: Monoprice Commercial Series 4x1 TV Ceiling Mount for Landscape Display Menu Boards Fits 32 to 65 TVs with Adjustable Tilt
product.description: Monoprice™Commercial Series 4×1 TV Ceiling Mount for Landscape Display Menu Boards, Fits 32" to 65" TVs with Adjustable TiltThe Monoprice Commercial Series 4×1 TV Ceiling Mount is designed for professional menu board and digital signage installations using four landscape oriented displays. It supports 32" to 65" TVs, provides adjustable tilt for improved viewing angles, and offers an extended ceiling drop range for high ceiling commercial environments. This mount consolidates four displays onto a single ceiling drop for clean alignment, reduced installation complexity, and consistent presentation across screens.FOUR LANDSCAPE DISPLAYS FROM ONE CEILING DROPThe mount uses a horizontal rail system engineered for a 4×1 landscape configuration, supporting four displays from a single ceiling pole assembly. This configuration is intended for commercial menu boards and information displays where uniform spacing and alignment are required. ADJUSTABLE TILT FOR IMPROVED READABILITYEach display interface supports fixed tilt positions up to 15°, allowing installers to optimize viewing angles based on ceiling height, screen size, and viewer position. EXTENDED CEILING DROP FOR COMMERCIAL INSTALLATIONSThe ceiling pole provides an adjustable vertical drop from 800 mm (31.5 in) minimum to 5010 mm (197.2 in) maximum, supporting a wide range of ceiling heights without custom fabrication. COMMERCIAL GRADE STEEL CONSTRUCTIONThe mount is constructed from steel and includes concrete anchors and lag bolts for permanent installation. It is intended for indoor use only and must be installed by qualified professionals. PACKAGE CONTENTS• Ceiling pole sections• Horizontal display rail• Four display mounting brackets• Concrete anchors and lag bolts• Assorted M5, M6, and M8 fasteners• Hardware Installation Pack• Printed user manual .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}Lifetime WarrantyWith Monoprice's Lifetime Warranty, you can rest assured we stand behind our products and our customers.
